jobs.title: Project Manager | Remote | AirStrip
jobs.description:
Are you ready to link your passion with a purpose?
At AirStrip, we build technology that enables clinicians to diagnose earlier than ever before, accelerate life-saving interventions, reduce the cost of care, and save lives.

We provide mobile-first clinical surveillance and alarm communication management technology that unlocks siloed data from patient monitors and transforms it into contextually rich information easily accessible on mobile devices and the Web. We’re seeking innovative thinkers who love doing meaningful work. If you’re looking to bring your skills and expertise to a growing technology company, it’s time for you to join us!

AirStrip is growing, and adding Project Managers to our implementation group within the Delivery Project Management Office. In this role, you'll plan, execute, and finalize projects according to the project management methodology which AirStrip uses to deliver its products and services to customers efficiently, effectively, and using a standardized approach to allow measurement and optimization of scalability, repeatability, and quality of delivery. You're an integral member of our team and will directly contribute to the success of AirStrip.

Please note, this position requires up to 50% travel, including overnight stays.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

Direct and manage delivery of projects from beginning to end, including creation of the Project Charter and Project Plan, leading team calls, tracking tasks and issues in an Action Log, tracking milestones and deliverables, performing risk management and contingency planning, and conducting lessons learned meetings at the end of projects
Effectively communicate project expectations to team members and stakeholders in a timely and clear fashion.
Set and continually manage project expectations with team members and other stakeholders.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to appropriate personnel.
Identify and resolve issues and conflicts within the project team.
Identify and manage project dependencies and critical path.
Plan and schedule project timelines and milestones using appropriate tools.
Develop and deliver progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations.
Proactively manage changes in project scope, identify potential crises, and devise contingency plans.
Define project success criteria and disseminate them to involved parties throughout project life cycle.
Conduct project postmortems and create a recommendations report in order to identify successful and unsuccessful project elements.

Education & Experience Requirements

Bachelor's Degree from a four-year college or university; in a technical field, healthcare field, or equivalent combination of education and work experience
In lieu of Bachelor's Degree, 5+ years of project management experience in healthcare or business with significant portions managing IT projects or technology deployment projects
Current Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, or actively in progress of obtaining
2+ years previous work experience in project support of similar experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Excellent communication, leadership, problem solving and analytical skills
Familiarity with project management tools and/or software packages
Experience working in a team-oriented collaborative environment
Ability to rapidly adapt and respond to changes in environment and priorities
Ability to elicit cooperation from senior management and other departments
Proven history of self-motivation and ability to work independently
Team Player, works well collaboratively and learns quickly
Detail oriented, ability to exhaust all resources when troubleshooting issues
Customer focused approach
Critical Thinking & Problem-Solving skills; Ownership & follow thru on multiple issue types
Effective time management skills.

The salary range for applicable US-based applicants to this position is below. The specific rate will depend on the successful candidate’s qualifications, prior experience as well as geographic location.

$81,500 - $98,000 base salary.

We value each of our employee’s total wellness.
From robust medical, dental, and vision insurance, to financial planning assistance, to physical and mental wellness discounts, and unlimited access to our online learning platform, we understand that our company succeeds when our employees succeed as individuals.

Additional Notable US-employee Benefits Include

Paid Time Off (hourly) / Flex Time Off (salaried) programs for Full Time employees
Growth and Development opportunities
401(k), including a 3% company match
Paid Holidays
Paid Parental Leave, including a flexible return-to-work program
Employee Assistance Program
Discounts on popular cell phone plan providers
Life & Disability Insurance
And more!

About The Company

Quik Hire Staffing is a leading recruitment agency dedicated to connecting top-tier talent with innovative organizations across various industries. With a commitment to excellence and client satisfaction, Quik Hire Staffing specializes in providing customized staffing solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses worldwide. Our extensive network, industry expertise, and focus on quality make us a trusted partner for both employers and job seekers. We pride ourselves on fostering long-term relationships and delivering value-driven staffing services that support organizational growth and success.

About The Role

The Strategic Project Manager (Finance) is a pivotal role within Quik Hire Staffing, designed for a highly motivated professional with a strong background in financial management and project leadership. This remote position offers the flexibility to work from anywhere, empowering candidates to lead high-impact financial initiatives across diverse organizational units. The successful candidate will oversee complex projects related to financial planning, analysis, and process optimization, ensuring strategic alignment and operational efficiency. This role demands excellent analytical skills, stakeholder management, and a proactive approach to problem-solving, with the goal of driving financial performance and supporting the company’s long-term objectives.

Qualifications

To be considered for this role, candidates should possess a minimum of 7 years of experience in finance, accounting, or financial project management. A strong proficiency in financial modeling, Excel, and ERP systems is essential. Candidates must demonstrate exceptional analytical abilities, with the capacity to interpret and synthesize complex financial data into actionable insights. Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing diverse stakeholder groups is highly valued. Additionally, a solid understanding of accounting standards such as GAAP and IFRS is required. A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field is mandatory, with advanced certifications like CPA, CFA, or CMA considered a plus.

Responsibilities

Lead strategic finance projects from initiation through execution, including budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis to ensure timely delivery and accuracy.
Collaborate closely with senior leadership to develop and refine financial strategies aligned with the company's long-term goals and vision.
Create and utilize financial models to assess project feasibility, evaluate potential ROI, and support decision-making processes.
Oversee financial reporting activities, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and internal policies to maintain transparency and accuracy.
Work with finance teams to streamline processes, implement best practices, and enhance operational efficiency across financial functions.
Monitor industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging best practices to continuously improve financial strategies and processes.
Manage stakeholder expectations through effective communication, reporting, and collaboration across departments.
Identify areas for cost optimization and process improvement, recommending strategic initiatives to enhance financial health.

Benefits

Quik Hire Staffing offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ well-being and professional growth. This includes competitive salary packages, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for career advancement. Employees gain access to ongoing training and development programs, enabling them to stay ahead in their field. Additionally, we provide health insurance coverage, paid time off, and wellness programs to promote a healthy work-life balance. Our remote work model ensures flexibility, allowing employees to create a work environment that suits their lifestyle. We also foster a collaborative and inclusive culture that values diversity, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Quik Hire Staffing is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We hire based on merit and skills, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply, and our selection process is solely based on demonstrated qualifications and ability to contribute to our clients’ success. We believe that diversity fosters innovation and strengthens our organization, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants.

The Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of the maintenance contract. This role ensures the effective execution of preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and hardware repair services, ensuring that all operations strictly adhere to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) in customer contracts. The position is accountable for operational excellence, team leadership, and the effective management of both engineering team, suppliers and subcontractors, while ensuring full compliance with safety requirements.

Contract Delivery & Management: Maintain full oversight of the maintenance contract, ensuring all service deliverables-including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and hardware repair-are executed in strict compliance with SLAs and technical requirements.

Customer & Performance Reporting: Prioritize regular, high-quality reporting to the customer to ensure transparency, trust, and alignment with contract expectations. Maintain accurate internal records and metrics for KPIs and volume parameters.

5-8 years of relevant experience in maintenance or service project management, specifically within the telecommunications industry.

Strong leadership and coordination skills, with a proven ability to manage internal teams and vendor/subcontractor.

Summary

This position is located within Commander, Navy Region Europe, Africa, Central (CNREURAFCENT) and serves as the Morale, Welfare and Recreation (MWR) Director. The purpose of this position is to provide technical assistance and guidance on policy issues that pertain to or affect the overall CNREURAFCENT MWR Programs.

Duties

Help

Plans and executes Regional MWR Programs through the administration, operation, and technical direction of all delivery systems and program components.

Manages, administers, and provides technical direction of MWR programs within Navy Region EURAFCENT.

Staffs/drafts replies to, or endorsements on correspondence about issues which may include coordination with region staff members; MWR Departments; Commander, Navy Installations Command (CNIC); other services; Office of the Secretary of Defense; Secretary of the Navy (SECNAV); or higher authority as necessary.

Periodically visits and tours other operations and incorporates best practices.

Evaluates, suggests, and serves as the technical expert to the Regional Fleet Readiness Director in matters relating to MWR.

Constantly updates and evaluates program components which is essential for provision of appropriate MWR programs and services.

Collaborates with Ashore Galleys for integrated food service approach.

Collaborates with CYP for integrated family readiness approach Liaison with CNIC Fleet Readiness.

Pursues additional revenue through aggressive sponsorship and advertising program.

Maintains database of installation programs, services, facilities, and specialized equipment.

Makes changes in organization of work and or assignment of functions to improve workflow, promote job satisfaction and increase productivity and cost effectiveness.

Recommends and justifies revisions in staffing levels, work priorities and deadlines.

Responsible for affecting appropriate position management principles throughout the program.

Coordinates budget requirements with Regional Fleet Readiness Director and provides general guidance for preparation of the annual budget. Monitors and provides technical advice involving management planning, cost control, and coordination of work force and resources; and provides expert advisory services to senior agency military and civilian management regarding cognizant programs. Total appropriated fund (APF) and non-appropriated fund (NAF) responsibility is $30M APF and $33M NAF.

Performs special projects and research/studies in coordination with the EURAFCENT Regional Fleet Readiness Director and various military and civilian professional technical experts in the development, administration, or operation of MWR programs and facilities.

Assists installations in working towards achieving program standards.

Prepares information, analysis, and follow-up reports following site visits, conferences, meetings, briefs, or presentations.

Interprets policy for MWR programs and operating policies that affect elements of the EURAFCENT MWR programs and other MWR agencies, and formulates correspondences concerning questions or policies for signature.

Ensures each department is operated in compliance with CNICINST 1710.3 and all other applicable instructions and regulations and generally accepted standards of the profession.

Serves as technical authority for MWR manuals, instructions, and policy statements.

Works with various teams to ensure regional MWR programs, and at times installation business offices, are operating most efficiently and effectively.

Promotes internal and external customer service and continuously supports and enables ongoing customer service training and development.

Performs general office functions including but not limited to filing, answering email, answering phones, copying, faxing, scanning, handling mail/FedEx, sorting mail, requesting supplies, etc.

Supervise one (1) Region MWR Program and Management Analyst.

Requirements

Help

Conditions of employment

Position is telework eligible.
Male candidates born after December 31, 1959, and at least 18 years of age, are required to certify that they have registered with the Selective Service System.
Position is Non-critical, Sensitive requiring access to IT II system and or access to PII. Position requires eligibility for a secret clearance. An access National Agency Check Investigation (NACl) is required via the SF86 security form.
Incumbent is required to submit a Financial Disclosure Statement, OGE Form-450 upon entering the position and annually, accordance with DoD Directive 5500-7R Joint Ethics Regulation.
Occasional travel may be required away from normal duty station.
Must possess and maintain a current valid driver's license, with ability to drive a personal and government vehicle.
May be required to work other than normal duty hours or overtime.

Qualifications

Applicant must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 or NF-04 grade level. Specialized experience includes administration, analysis, and oversight of military recreation programs.

A qualified candidate possess the following:

Knowledge in the application of the principles, concepts, and methodology for the management of Navy MWR programs.

Knowledge of appropriate DoD, SECNA V, CNIC, and other program policies and regulations covering all areas of administrative and operational policies and procedures.

Ability to formulate management techniques or practices to accommodate unique or special problems or situations related to MWR.

Skill and ability to perform as a leader to influence the actions of others in obtaining cooperation and assistance to accomplish the MWR mission.

Knowledge and skill in the application of a wide range of qualitative methods for the assessment, improvement, and effectiveness of complex management programs and systems.

Skill in program planning and projection, organizing, and administration to devise and carry out the variety of exceptionally complex program components and services in Navy Region EURAFCENT.

Knowledge of Equal Employment Opportunity program and objectives.

Knowledge of budgeting, financial management and planning, project planning and initiation, as well as, construction and special projects.

Skill in the use of computers, a variety of software programs, and methods of record keeping.

Skill in writing reports and correspondence.

Skill in dealing tactfully with contacts and utilizing negotiation skills.

Ability to conduct orientations, briefings, general meetings, and extensive in-service staff training.

Ability to appraise different program elements, and evaluate similarities and differences according to their respective missions as they relate to the regional MWR Programs.

Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.

Additional information

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Program Manager in the Chapters Affairs Department supports the mission, agenda and strategic plan of the ACC, the ACC domestic Chapters, and the Board of Governors (BOG). The BOG is a leadership body comprising elected representatives from every state and other entities. The Associate will advise and partner with BOG leaders, ACC domestic Chapter Executives, and department staff in the management and oversight of the College’s domestic Chapters, and lead and support in the implementation of ACC programs through interaction with Chapter leaders and other staff.

The Program Manager serves as the Chapter Executive for ACC-managed Chapters and provides strategic, operational, financial, and governance leadership to Chapter offices and volunteer leaders,

Domestic Chapters and ACC National, though incorporated separately, collaborate extensively toward the common goal of transforming cardiovascular care and improving heart health. Chapters and ACC National share this mission with a focus on education, advocacy, quality improvement, member value and engagement, and member-driven values.

Responsibilities

Serving as the primary strategic and operational advisor to Chapter Presidents, Governors, and volunteer leaders.
Working with the Chapter Presidents, Governors and other volunteer leaders on the administration of the Chapter, member programming, annual budgeting, tax preparation, and other Chapter activities.
Developing annual priorities, work plans, budgets, and programs aligned with ACC and Chapter strategic goals.
Providing oversight of Chapter governance, financial operations, compliance, contracts, and organizational records.
Identifying operational challenges and recommending solutions to strengthen Chapter performance and sustainability
Represents ACC National at Board of Governors, Chapter, and national meetings to strengthen relationships, support volunteer leadership, and advance Chapter and College priorities

Functions as the primary staff liaison between ACC and the Chapter Executives including working with the Chair of the Chapter Executives, scheduling monthly meetings with the Chapter Executives, and planning at least two in-person meeting with the Chapter Executives per year.
Assists in the logistical support and on-site management of two in-person BOG meetings per year and one annual virtual meeting.
Oversees the end-to-end recruitment and selection process for new Chapter Executives, including:
Development and distribution of requests for proposals.
Coordination of interviews and candidate evaluation.
Support for contracting, transition planning, and organizational continuity.

Leads the annual Chapter Section Grants program, including:
Updating program information and application materials.
Managing the application and review process.
Convening and supporting the selection committee.
Communicating award decisions.
Soliciting progress reports.
Partnering with Finance to distribute funds.
Evaluating program outcomes and recommending improvements.

Serves as a trusted advisor to the BOG members, Chapter Executives and Chapters in meeting their needs through timely responses to email, phone, and mail inquiries.
Provides guidance and resolution for Chapter Membership questions, policies and operational issues.
Collaborate with staff from all departments within the College to support member-driven programmatic initiatives.
Directs operational planning and logistics including announcements, tracking invitations, travel policy implementation, travel reimbursement reports and follow-up in coordination with other staff members for several large meetings annually.
Partners with chapter leaders and other staff to advance engagement for various member categories, including Fellow in Training and Early Career, at the Chapter level.
Leads strategic projects and process improvements that strengthen Chapter operations, governance, and member engagement.
Develops tools, resources, and operating standards to improve consistency and efficiency across ACC-managed Chapters.
Analyzes Chapter trends, operational data, and stakeholder feedback to inform planning and recommendations.
Represents Chapter Affairs in discussions with senior volunteer leaders, members, partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree
7+ years experience in association or nonprofit management
Strong skills with Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and SurveyMonkey
Excellent communication skills
Attention to detail and ability to complete assigned tasks within established deadlines
Work effectively in a team environment
15% travel required
Health care association experience, preferred
Membership database administration experience, such as Salesforce preferred

About Us

At the American College of Cardiology, we bring our hearts to work.

We are a 500-person organization dedicated and committed to our mission to transform cardiovascular care and improve heart health for all for more than 75 years. When you join our team, you become part of a culture that envisions a world where science, innovation and knowledge optimize cardiovascular care and outcomes.

Every day, we are committed to supporting our more than 60,000 members and their patients around the globe and in doing so, ensure our staff have a positive environment of teamwork, collaboration, professionalism and excellence. To learn more about why ACC has been recognized as a great place to work, please visit our site, www.acc.org/jobs .

ACC values all members of our College family, including ACC staff. As the foundation of the organization, ACC staff enjoy world-class benefits and a culture of work-life balance. Our benefit offerings include insurance (medical, dental, vision, basic life, and short- and long-term disability, and supplemental options), generous paid time off (pre-loaded vacation and sick, 12 holidays and an organizational shut-down during the last week of the year, parental leave, 2 community service days, and half-day summer Fridays), tuition assistance and a very competitive 10% retirement contribution after a year of service, and much more! You can visit our careers site for an overview of our full offerings. Please note that these offerings may change at any time.

ACC believes in fair and equitable pay. Multiple factors are taken into consideration when we determine what salary to offer a selected candidate. These factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, as well as internal equity, market, and business considerations. As the largest paediatric health service in Australia, we care for thousands of children each year, in hospital and at home. Our people are united by compassion, collaboration and excellence in care.

What You'll Be Doing

The National Centre for Immunisation Research and Surveillance of Vaccine Preventable Diseases (NCIRS) is the leading research organisation in Australia that provides objective expert advice on all aspects of vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs), vaccines, and other issues related to immunisation, to inform policy and planning for immunisation services in Australia and to support the control of VPDs across the whole life-course. NCIRS also has a growing Global Health program that works to support countries, particularly those in the Asia-Pacific region, on their immunisation system strengthening efforts. This work is funded through agreements with the Australian and New South Wales governments, including the Australian Centre for Disease Control, as well as other funding agencies.

The Program Manager, Program Management is responsible for the operational and leadership and management of the awarded contract of funding for NCIRS. The role is accountable for supporting the timely delivery of high-quality outputs, monitoring performance against contractual obligations, and ensuring compliance with funding agreements with the Australian Government Department of Health and Aged Care, Australian Centre for Disease Control, the NSW Ministry of Health or other NCIRS work contracts.

Working in a complex research and public health environment, the position applies extensive knowledge of health research, and sound knowledge translation and program operations to support effective planning, resource coordination and service delivery across the two streams. The role works collaboratively with stream leads, researchers and internal and external stakeholders to optimise operational performance, strengthen partnerships and ensure programs are responsive to organisational priorities, contractual commitments and emerging public health needs.

The Program Manager, Program Management contribute to organisational planning and continuous improvement by supporting effective governance, operational risk management and performance monitoring across the assigned streams. The role exercises independent judgement in resolving operational issues, coordinating competing priorities and implementing improvements that enhance service delivery and organisational effectiveness.

The primary purpose of this role is to contribute to the delivery of high-quality research and operational support activities within the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network (SCHN), ensuring excellence in research administration, program coordination and stakeholder engagement.

Experience managing complex customer, operational, financial, CRM or other enterprise data migrations
Strong understanding of migration governance, data reconciliation, testing, cutover and hypercare
Experience managing multiple vendors and senior stakeholder groups

jobs.title: Digital Program Manager (Guangzhou, China)
jobs.description:
Job Responsibilities:
1.Portfolio Visibility & Horizontal Tracking
• Centralized Reporting: Maintain the "Single Source of Truth" for the Group Digital Portfolio. You aggregate status updates from various project teams into a consolidated Master Dashboard that provides horizontal visibility across all markets (HK, SG, SEA).
• Status Validation: Act as the "integrity check" for the portfolio. You ensure that the data entered by Project Managers matches the reality of the resource plan (e.g., verifying that a project marked "On Track" actually has resources booked).
2.Risk Identification & Escalation
• Bottleneck Detection: Proactively identify resource conflicts and scheduling overlaps before they become critical issues. (e.g., "Developer A is double-booked across Project X and Project Y next week").
• Ripple Effect Analysis: When a project delay occurs, you are responsible for mapping the downstream impact. You visually flag how a delay in the current sprint affects future projects in the pipeline, ensuring stakeholders understand the consequences of their changes.
3.Resolution Tracking & Facilitation
• Drive Resolution: Once a risk is flagged, you prompt the relevant owners (Banner PMs, Product Managers, Tech Leads) to provide a solution. You do not decide the solution, but you enforce the requirement for a decision to be made.
• Scenario Planning: Provide "What-If" data to stakeholders to help them choose the best path (e.g., "If we prioritize Project A, Project B moves next month. Please confirm decision.").
• Conflict Log: Maintain a log of operational risks and agreed resolutions to ensure that decisions are executed and do not get lost in daily operations.
4.Annual Digital Roadmap & Pipeline Orchestration
• Banner Planning Integration: Partner with Banners and cross functional stakeholder (Digital Product, Finance etc) during the annual roadmap cycle to ensure all proposed digital initiatives are captured with the necessary required information (KPIs, high-level requirements, man-day cost, ROI etc).
• Standardized Submission Management: Drive the use of unified templates for all roadmap submissions, ensuring that business units provide consistent, high-quality data to facilitate cross-functional review.
• Cross-Functional Synchronization: Facilitate alignment between Banners, Tech, and Finance teams to ensure a "single source of truth" regarding the scope and intent of projects submitted for budget approval.
• Post-Approval Transition: Manage the seamless handover of approved projects from the planning phase into active tracking, ensuring that initial roadmap commitments are accurately reflected in the Master Dashboard.

Qualifications and requirements:
1.Experience: 5 to 7 years of experience in PMO or Program Management with a specific focus on horizontal portfolio management rather than vertical project delivery.
2.Roadmap Orchestration: Proven track record in facilitating annual or quarterly digital roadmap planning cycles, ensuring business requests are translated into structured, technically viable initiatives.
3.Matrix Expertise: Proven experience working in a Regional Hub or Matrix Organization is mandatory. You must be comfortable coordinating across diverse markets such as HK, SG, and Vietnam.
4.Domain Knowledge: Prior exposure to Retail, E-commerce, or Digital Product teams is highly preferred.
5.Strategic Intake Design: Ability to define and collect information required for roadmap submissions (e.g., business cases, high-level dependencies, and success metrics) using standardized templates.
6.Data Mastery for Tracking: Advanced Excel proficiency (Pivot Tables, Power Query) is still required to maintain the "Single Source of Truth" and visualize ripple-effect risks once the roadmap moves into execution.
7.Cross-Functional Alignment: Demonstrated skill in aligning diverse stakeholders (Banners, Tech, Finance) to ensure everyone is on the same page regarding the scope and priority of roadmap submissions.
8.Language: Fluent English and Mandarin (Written & Spoken) are mandatory to explain complex roadmap trade offs and timeline conflicts to regional stakeholders.
9.Assertive Coordination: You are comfortable "influencing without authority," following up with stakeholders for updates, and ensuring answers are received, not just emails forwarded.
10.Proactive Problem Solving: You identify "Yellow" warning signs early to prevent them from turning into "Red" failures.

jobs.description:
About Us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Energy Systems

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

About The Role

Are you passionate about renewable energy and ready to make a tangible impact? Do you thrive on managing end-to-end projects and customer relationships? Are you excited to join a dynamic and collaborative team that is shaping the future of sustainable power? If so, apply now for the Project Manager role at GreenPowerMonitor (GPM). Together, we can create a greener tomorrow!

You will drive planning, execution, and delivery of key projects focused on implementing GPM data-driven digital solutions (SCADA &PPC) for the control, monitoring, and asset management of renewable energy sites, including photovoltaic, wind, and battery storage. You will collaborate closely with our customers and internal teams to ensure successful project outcomes.

Your Key Responsibilities

Oversee end-to-end project management, from the receipt of the Purchase Order to the successful delivery and final acceptance by the customer
Define project requirements to ensure alignment with customer needs and develop detailed project plans, including milestones, timelines, resource allocation, and risk management
Supervise and delegate project tasks across Project Engineers and cross-functional teams (logistics, purchasing, IT, GI,…) ensuring efficient task distribution and execution
Oversee purchasing and supplier assignments, ensuring timely procurement of materials and services required for project success
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while meeting customer requirements and quality standards
Act as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships and expectations throughout the project lifecycle
Write technical reports and communicate progress, challenges, and solutions to stakeholders, both internally and externally on a regular basis
Continuously drive process improvements and best practices in project management

The team awaiting you…

You will join our Project Execution team in the On-site Solutions area. Our commitment is to successfully deliver On-site Solutions (SCADA and PPC) projects, while ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, and budget constraints. This involves a comprehensive approach that not only prioritizes excellence but also emphasizes efficiency and performance to provide the optimum experience and highest quality to our customers. To achieve this, we actively create specific tools and automation processes, enabling us to deliver intelligently and uphold our position as industry leaders.

GreenPowerMonitor, a DNV company, is at the heart of the global energy transformation. We use data-driven digital solutions to optimise the performance of renewable energy installations around the world. Our work contributes to a more diverse, more sustainable global energy mix.

What we offer

Wellbeing: DNV understands the importance of physical and mental wellbeing and aligned with our value of caring for our people, we have a ‘Be Well’ program in place.
Bonus opportunity: We believe it is important to reward our employees with an annual discretionary profit scheme or sales incentive scheme – depending on your role.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Promise modernizes how government agencies and utilities support people in financial difficulty. We build technology that makes it simple for residents to receive benefits, engage with assistance programs, set up flexible payment plans, and stay on track—while helping agencies increase efficiency, recover revenue, and deliver services with dignity. Our mission is to transform public systems so they work better for everyone, especially the most vulnerable.

Our team includes experts from companies like Palantir, Google, Stripe , and esteemed government leaders. We work hard and believe deeply in what we do. We're looking for excellent people to build innovative, resilient technology.

Backed by over $50 million in funding from top investors – such as Reid Hoffman, Howard Schultz, Michael Seibel, Y Combinator, 8VC, The General Partnership, First Round Capital, Kapor Capital, XYZ Ventures, and Bronze Investments – Promise has been recognized as one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies of 2022,” “Forbes Next Billion-Dollar Startups 2024,” and Y Combinator’s #1 GovTech startup.

About The Role

As a Deployment Strategist at Promise
, you’ll be on the front lines of impact—owning outcomes, not tasks. You’ll work hand-in-hand with government and utility partners to deeply understand their operations, pain points, and goals—then translate those insights into real, scalable solutions that drive measurable results.

This is not a passive customer success role. You’ll build
, problem-solve
, and strategize
to ensure every deployment delivers lasting value—to our customers, their constituents, and Promise’s bottom line. You’ll push projects from launch to long-term growth, always focused on outcomes that matter: adoption, efficiency, revenue impact, and customer success.

If you love digging into complexity, building strong and lasting customer relationships, and delivering time-critical solutions to meaningful real world problems, this may be the role for you.

What You’ll Do

Build real solutions: Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to design and deliver systems that integrate seamlessly into customer workflows and drive measurable impact.
Own outcomes: Take full accountability for the success of each customer—from implementation to renewal, expansion, and long-term value creation.
Understand customers deeply: Get into the weeds of customer operations, data, and challenges until you can articulate their business better than they can.
Provide a world-class experience: Ensure that every customer touchpoint is high-quality, high-substance, and unforgettable. Our customers should feel lucky to work with us.
Drive value and growth: Translate understanding into action plans that boost adoption, revenue, and efficiency—ensuring Promise becomes an indispensable partner.
Turn insight into innovation: Surface what’s working (and what’s not) from the field to influence product direction and future investments.
Build authentic trust: Build strong relationships across all levels—from line staff to senior executives—by showing up in a high-quality way and delivering highly effective, innovative solutions.
Get onsite: Nothing builds credibility and trust like spending in-person time with the customer, this role is approximately 40% travel.

What Will Help You Succeed

Experience: 3+ years in roles driving real outcomes—consulting, strategy, implementation, or customer success—ideally in govtech.
Builder’s mindset: You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and care about building systems that actually work in the real world.
Customer obsession: You go beyond surface needs to understand the “why” behind every request and solve for long-term success.
Analytical horsepower: You’re fluent in data, financial models, and metrics that define success—and you use them to guide decision-making.
Eye for growth: You recognize opportunities for upsell, renewal, and expansion while strengthening customer trust and alignment.
Cross-functional collaboration: You know how to turn insights from the field into product innovation by working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers, PMs, and designers.
Flexibility & grit: You’re energized by being close to the customer, field work, and the challenges of solving gnarly problems at scale.

Who Thrives At Promise

You’ll love it here if:

You are energized by big, complex challenges and the opportunity to solve them.
You want your work to have a real, measurable impact on people’s lives.
You take ownership and run toward problems, not away from them.
You value clear, candid, and constructive communication.

Promise Is Not For You If

You prefer hierarchy and rigid structures. We operate with freedom and responsibility.
You are uncomfortable with change. We move fast, adapt often, and expect agility.
You want a typical corporate culture. We are mission-driven, ambitious, and direct.
You believe efficiency means “doing less.” We believe efficiency means doing better.

How We Enable Our People

100% paid health coverage
Flexible-time-off (take what you need) and sick leave
Lunch, snacks, and coffee provided in office
Company retreats
Opportunities to travel and see the impact of your work directly
Hybrid work: we deeply value in-person collaboration and are in-office at least 4 days a week, but are flexible on what people need

Promise is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant or employee because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, age, or military or veteran status. Additionally, the Company complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every jurisdiction in which it operates. Promise is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We also provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, pregnant individuals, and those with sincerely held religious beliefs, in accordance with applicable laws. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@joinpromise.com.

Promise engages in US government contracts and restricts hiring to US persons, which includes US citizens and permanent residents (e.g., Green Card holders). Additionally, candidates must reside in the US.

About The Role

As an Intel Analyst supporting a national defense program space warfighting mission, you will be responsible for providing actionable data through briefed intelligence reports that inform decision-makers and broader Intelligence Community of counterspace (kinetic and non-kinetic) threats and assessed vulnerabilities to space & ground assets conducting 24/7 mission protection operations. This Intel Analyst position is best filled by an expert on terrestrial and on-orbit counterspace threats, capable of guiding research and shaping assessments with team members working in a space operations-focused Intelligence Division. You will work closely with flight safety and mission protection staff and support Indication & Warning (I&W) system integration efforts that progress database accuracy and efficiencies in mission execution. Additionally, the successful candidate will continuously endeavor to close organizational knowledge gaps in an ever-changing space domain environment via committed collaboration, expert collection analysis and balanced resource tasking.

Apply advanced Intel analysis skills to lead team tasks and disseminate actionable space intel to decision-makers across six geographically separated space operations centers
Research and employ an operational mindset when developing intel assessments and build solutions toward improved organizational space domain awareness
Lead training development efforts and advise strategic and exercise planning events
Collaborate frequently across divisions (i.e., flight safety, plans, mission protection, strategy and plans, engineering etc.) and respond to object and assessment inquiries
Maintain data resources and system expertise to execute real world event procedures
Shape confident intel assessments and warn of threats to mission critical space and ground assets; develop new tactics, techniques and procedures TTPs for operations
Lead and/or attend meetings as required; provide space intelligence knowledge as a resource to senior military and civilian government customers

***This position is contingent upon award of contract***

Qualifications

8 years with BS/BA; 6 years with MS/MA; 3 years with PhD; 12+ years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree
Experience working in an intelligence community and/or military intel career field
Experience working Defensive Space Control, Intelligence Analysis roles

Join the Pennsylvania Commission on Crime and Delinquency as a Program Analyst 3 and help strengthen programs that support safer schools and communities. This role allows you to work with partners across the state while shaping training, guidance, and evaluation tools. You will make a meaningful impact by improving the way important programs operate. This position supports the Pennsylvania Commission on Crime and Delinquency (PCCD) by improving training, evaluation, program coordination, and compliance work across multiple statewide initiatives. It plays a central role in helping internal staff and external partners succeed by providing guidance, analysis, and technical assistance. As a Program Analyst 3, you will perform the following duties:

Technical Guidance: Develop recommendations and assist organizations in meeting statutory and regulatory requirements
Training Development: Create training materials, manage learning modules, and collaborate with subject experts

jobs.description:
Job Description

Associate Business Analyst/Business Analyst/Advanced Business Analyst

FirstEnergy at a Glance

We are a forward-thinking electric utility powered by a diverse team of employees committed to making customers’ lives brighter, the environment better and our communities stronger.

FirstEnergy (NYSE: FE) is dedicated to integrity, safety, reliability and operational excellence. Headquartered in Akron, Ohio, FirstEnergy includes one of the nation's largest investor-owned electric systems, more than 24,000 miles of transmission lines that connect the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, and a regulated generating fleet with a total capacity of more than 3,500 megawatts.

About The Opportunity

This is an open position with FirstEnergy Service Company, a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corporation. It is an onsite position that can be in Akron, OH.

This position offers the opportunity to be a key member of the FirstEnergy Remittance Processing and Controls Operations, assisting with defined payment platforms and the creativity to enhance the operations to effectively meet financial, operational, and compliance objectives. The Remittance and Processing Controls group is also responsible for ensuring customer satisfaction and payment efficiencies related to all payment channels impacting Customer Service.

Working in Regulated Settlements provides an opportunity to learn about the PJM energy and capacity market as well as how retail shopping impacts utility operations. In this role, the selected candidate will interact with PJM and third-party suppliers; learn how wholesale settlement functions influence activity at PJM; and understand. how certain changes in federal and state regulations impact our Company.

Regulated Settlements interacts routinely with team members from Customer Care, Regulated Commodity Sourcing, FERC & RTO Technical Support, RTO Energy Transactions, Metering & Support Systems, Rates & Regulatory Affairs, and Information Technology. We also participate as members of the PJM Market Settlements and PJM Demand Response subcommittees.

Responsibilities Include

This position develops and analyzes customer hourly energy data used by various FirstEnergy internal business groups and external organizations; specifically, PJM and Retail Energy Suppliers for invoicing and reporting.

Prepare and submit accurate and timely energy, capacity, and transmission data to PJM on a daily, monthly, and annual basis.
Query, validate, analyze, and organize large amounts of data into meaningful results.
Prepare and validate weekly, monthly, and annual reports for internal / external sources.
Utilize various mathematical principles such as regression equations and algebra.
Assist with key projects and implement improvement initiatives related to processing and analyzing customer energy data and resolving data discrepancies.
Understand concepts related to operating in Regional Transmission Organization and electric industry principles such as PJM energy and capacity markets, demand response, energy efficiency, customer choice, and customer electric use patterns.
Coordinate and participate in meetings with various internal departments regarding metering and supplier data information.
Keep sensitive customer information secured.
Demonstrate commitment to all aspects of safety and the Company’s diversity and inclusion principles.
Provide a high level of customer service and responsiveness while building relationships and credibility across the organization.
Conduct business specific research, interpret results, and make recommendations.
Consistently anticipate and deliver against a defined action plan.
Contribute to solutions by taking initiative to develop alternatives and recommendations.

An employee hired at the Advanced Business Analyst, Senior Business Analyst or Staff Business Analyst level will be expected to perform all the above responsibilities with more proficiency, and in a more independent manner. Further, the Advanced Business Analyst, Senior Business Analyst or Staff Business Analyst level employee will be assigned additional responsibilities related to those above.

Qualifications At The Assistant Business Analyst Level Include

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Mathematics, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related disciplinerequired. In lieu of a degree, 4 years of relevant work experience is required.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Experience with Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Access, and Word.
Desire to work on assignments with firm daily, monthly, and annual timelines.
Demonstrate a questioning attitude to continue to learn and grow, work across FirstEnergy, and deliver results.
Deliver quality, accurate work within established deadlines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Qualifications at the Associate Business Analyst level include the above, plus:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Mathematics, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline with 2years of relevant work experience required. In lieu of a degree, 7 years of relevant work experience is required.
Experience working with large data sets such as querying, data analysis and reporting, identifying and acting on process improvements, and an in-depth understanding of the relevant subject matter.
Understand meaningful associations between tables and databases that contain related information.
Demonstrated experience with reading and writing ad hoc SQL statements and queries.
Working knowledge of querying tools (i.e., Toad for Oracle, SAS) and SAP is a plus.
Understand best practices and techniques for addressing customer concerns.

Qualifications at the Business Analyst level include the above, plus:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Mathematics, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline with 4 years of relevant work experience required. In lieu of a degree, 7 years of relevant work experience is required.
Relevant experience includes working with large data sets such as querying, data analysis and reporting, identifying and acting on process improvements, and an in-depth understanding of the relevant subject matter.
Highly proficient with Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Access, and Word.
Adept at queries, report writing, process improvement, and presenting findings.
Significant experience with reading and writing ad hoc SQL statements and queries.
Utility and/or regional transmission organization experience is a plus.
Identifying and acting on process improvements.
Conduct business specific research, interpret results, and make recommendations.

Qualifications at the Advanced Business Analyst level include the above, plus:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Mathematics, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline with 7 years of professional work experience required. In lieu of a degree, 10 years of relevant work experience is required.

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Your Job

KBX is seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive strategic business outcomes. This role is responsible for aligning stakeholders, managing risk, influencing decisions, and ensuring successful delivery of projects that create long-term value for the organization.

You will serve as a trusted partner to business and technology leaders, bring structure to ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and guide teams through complex decisions. Success in this role requires strong leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to influence without direct authority while balancing competing priorities and organizational objectives.

Our Team

This role is part of a centralized team responsible for enabling the successful delivery of strategic initiatives across KBX. The team partners closely with leaders throughout the organization to prioritize investments, align resources, and execute projects that improve business performance, scalability, and customer value. As a key contributor, you will collaborate across functions and levels of the organization, helping teams navigate change, remove barriers, and deliver measurable business results.

What You Will Do

Lead complex, cross-functional projects and initiatives from concept through implementation, ensuring alignment to business objectives and strategic priorities.
Establish project governance, execution strategies, and stakeholder alignment to achieve successful outcomes.
Partner with business and technology leaders to define scope, priorities, success measures, and expected value.
Develop and manage project plans, budgets, timelines, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements.
Facilitate decision-making by identifying trade-offs, evaluating risks, and providing recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
Influence and align cross-functional teams, vendors, and business partners to drive execution and accountability.
Anticipate obstacles, proactively remove roadblocks, and navigate competing priorities in a dynamic environment.
Communicate project health, risks, opportunities, and strategic recommendations to stakeholders, including senior leadership.
Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance project delivery practices, team effectiveness, and business outcomes.
Promote a culture of collaboration, ownership, and value creation across project teams.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Experience leading projects and initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, teams, and business functions
Experience influencing stakeholders and driving alignment across groups
Experience managing project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, dependencies, and deliverables
Experience communicating project strategy, progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders
Experience leading initiatives through ambiguity, organizational change, or evolving business requirements
Experience applying various project management frameworks, methodologies, and tools to achieve business outcomes
Experience learning a new business, technical, or operational topic within a short timeframe
Experience developing communications for multiple stakeholder groups requiring different messaging approaches
Experience translating technical concepts or project impacts into communications that enable stakeholder understanding and decision-making

What Will Put You Ahead

Experience leading enterprise-wide initiatives or programs
Experience partnering directly with senior leaders to prioritize work, resolve issues, and drive strategic outcomes
Experience supporting business transformation, process improvement, integration, or merger and acquisition initiatives
Experience managing external vendors, consultants, or strategic partners
Experience influencing project governance, portfolio planning, or resource prioritization decisions
Experience within transportation, logistics, supply chain, or technology-focused environments
Experience identifying and implementing opportunities that improve organizational effectiveness and scalability

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

Who We Are

KBX Logistics, a Koch company and global leader in transportation, offers world-class, technology-driven capabilities across all modes of managed freight and transportation asset management. KBX is uniquely positioned to meet the challenges shippers face, leveraging decades of firsthand experience and data-driven insights from a large, diverse, and global business network. By building mutually beneficial partnerships and innovative technology, KBX creates a competitive advantage for its customers and meets the growing need for cost effective and reliable supply chain solutions. For more information on KBX, visit www.kbx.com

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. jobs.description:
Description

iSoftStone, Inc. is Seeking a Senior Business Analyst to Join our Team in New York!

This is a Hybrid Role in the New York City Metro Area

Candidates must have permanent authorization to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join the engagement team through discovery and translate workshop findings into the detailed requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria that will drive a major DAM and media delivery modernization. This is a highly visible, requirements-ownership role on a marquee multi-brand retail account, working directly with e-commerce, marketing, and technology stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

• Elicit and document detailed functional requirements through stakeholder workshops and interviews across e-commerce/studio, marketing/brand, and technology teams, translating high-level priorities into requirements and acceptance criteria the delivery team can build against.
• Define migration scope and criteria — working with the technology team to translate audit findings (asset counts, sizes, master locations) into concrete migration rules (e.g., SKU activity, inventory/orders).
• Integration requirements — specifying how the DAM must exchange status, rights, and product/SKU metadata with adjacent production/rights and product-data systems, including the asset-level (not just project-level) publishing behavior stakeholders need.
• Own the requirements backlog and traceability — maintaining requirements, decisions, and open questions across all delivery phases so scope stays traceable from discovery through governance and hypercare as it's refined.
• Support UAT and acceptance testing — translating requirements into test scenarios and validating delivered functionality (taxonomy, permissions, integrations, derivative rules) against them before phase gates and cutover.

Qualifications:

• Five+ years of business analysis experience on enterprise software or platform implementation programs, ideally including a DAM, CMS, PIM, or content-operations system.

• Demonstrated experience running requirements-elicitation workshops with cross-functional business stakeholders (e-commerce, marketing/creative, and technology) and turning findings into clear, testable requirements.
• Working knowledge of digital asset management concepts: metadata schema, taxonomy, rights/usage management, and master-plus-derivative asset strategy.
• Strong documentation skills — requirements specs, process maps, traceability matrices, and UAT test scripts.
• Comfort working with integration requirements between a DAM/Ecomm and adjacent systems (production/rights, product/SKU/PIM platforms).
• Excellent stakeholder communication, able to translate between business, creative, and technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience specifically with Cloudinary, Adobe AEM Assets, or Scene7/Dynamic Media.

• Background in fashion, apparel, or accessories retail, particularly multi-brand organizations with brand-specific taxonomy needs.
• Familiarity with agile/hybrid delivery methodologies and backlog tools.

Position Description & Qualifications

We’re seeking a dynamic and experienced Project Manager to join Serco’s Naval Acquisition and Sustainment Operation (NASO). A successful candidate will assume a critical role in overseeing and leading engineering and technical services to support maintenance and planning for the overhaul and repair equipment and systems associated with U.S. Navy Surface Ships. This position will be located in Pearl Harbor, HI.

This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain your DoD Secret level clearance.

Serco’s Naval Acquisition and Sustainment Operation is part of our high-performing Maritime, Engineering, Technology, and Sustainment Business Unit which provides critical services to nearly all U.S. Navy surface ships, submarines and craft and is achieving truly impactful outcomes. Serco has over 9,000 people in North America, with operations across the U.S. and Canada. We are committed to forming long-term partnerships and supporting Federal and State government customers to achieve their mission.

In This Role You Will

Lead teams providing technical guidance to Ship's Force relating to work on Hull, Mechanical & Electrical (HM&E) and aviation equipment and systems which interface with combat support systems, and hull support items such as damage control equipment for flooding and fire, climate control/ventilation systems, tank and voids, plenums, etc., habitability improvements, and piping systems. Also encompassed are electrical generation, power and distribution systems including controllers, junction boxes, cabling, and cableways.
Lead the performance of inspections, examinations, analysis, repairs incidental to such and make recommendations in the areas of maintenance planning and/or repair as requested on naval propulsion and auxiliary machinery associated with high pressure steam propulsion plants and U.S. Naval Surface Force Ship propulsion plants and auxiliaries.
Liaison with ship’s reactor department is required prior to accomplishing inspections, testing, and production work
Manage teams performing, assisting, or providing technical guidance on the performance of fault identification and support Ship's Force with physical repairs of the types of naval propulsion and auxiliary and aviation/flight deck equipment/combat systems and systems set forth herein
Responsible for technical support and advice to Ship's Force pertinent to the operation, overhaul, and repair of specific items of, auxiliary machinery, electrical, and hull support and aviation systems as directed by the appropriate technical authority.
Oversee the performance or provide guidance IAW Corrosion Control Assessment and Maintenance Manual (CCAMM) for the Maintenance System Work Package Planning (MSWP) (T-9630-ABMMD-010/all USN hulls) to Ship's Force with training, inspection and reporting of tanks, voids, plenums, bilges, catwalks, pump room decks, and Aqueous Film Forming Foam (AFFF) station decks. Perform or provide technical guidance in support of TYCOM Cableway Improvement Program (CIP) in accordance with NAVSEAINST 9304 series to Ship's Force with training, inspection, repair assistance and reporting.
Develop updated training package to the TYCOM and to the RMCs. Provide formal on-board operator and maintenance training to Ship’s Force.
Develop Formal Work Packages (FWPs) and Controlled Work Packages (CWPs) in accordance with the Joint Fleet Maintenance Manual.

An active DoD security clearance is required.
Three years should be closely involved with practical surface ship maintenance, design, operation, and other problems of main propulsion, auxiliary,electrical, and damage control equipment associated with shipboard level maintenance.
Two years direct experience with auxiliary, electrical, and damage control systems and included steam propulsion plants.
Two years direct experience with auxiliary, electrical and damage control systems for U.S. Naval Ships.
Two years of supervisory experience.
Up to 25% of travel for CONUS/OCONUS may be required.

Knowledge, Ability And Skills

Knowledge of best practice maritime processes and support methodologies to meet Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) requirements.
Ability to lead and manage large teams.
Ability to operate personal computers and have good knowledge and operational abilities with Microsoft Office tools.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
À propos de d²X

d²X est un cabinet européen de conseil spécialisé dans l’accompagnement à la transformation des systèmes d’information, pour de grands comptes privés et établissements publics dans la sécurisation de leurs engagements et la réussite de leurs projets IT et métier.

Nos expertises s’articulent autour de plusieurs offres structurées :
Garantie les projets, programmes et produits
Sourcing advisory
Cloud et IA advisory
Service Excellence
Transformation management

Fort de 200 collaborateurs
, le groupe est présent en France et à l’international à travers 5 agences
(Genève, Paris, Nantes, Lyon, Bruxelles).

Notre organisation en agences favorise l’agilité, la proximité managériale et l’expertise terrain
, au cœur de notre ADN qui
permet à nos collaborateurs d’être en situation de réussite tout en se sentant soutenus, responsabilisés, encouragés et inspirés.
Votre parcours professionnel sera soutenu par la formation continue et du mentorat.

Nos valeurs : Esprit d’équipe, engagement, intégrité, excellence, audace
.

Le rôle

En tant que Business Analyst
, vous intervenez au cœur des projets de transformation, en assurant le lien entre les parties prenantes métiers, les équipes IT et le pilotage de projet.

Selon la mission, vos responsabilités pourront notamment inclure :

Analyser les processus métiers et systèmes d’information existants
et identifier les opportunités d’amélioration.
Recueillir, challenger et formaliser les besoins métiers et exigences fonctionnelles
.
Traduire les besoins métiers en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et exploitables.
Animer des ateliers avec les parties prenantes métiers et techniques.
Modéliser les processus et les exigences à l’aide d’approches telles que UML et BPMN
.
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les chefs de projet, Product Owners, architectes et équipes de développement.
Définir et coordonner les scénarios de tests et les phases de recette utilisateur (UAT)
.
Accompagner les parties prenantes métiers tout au long des phases de test, de déploiement et de mise en œuvre.
Veiller à ce que la documentation projet soit claire, structurée et régulièrement mise à jour.
Contribuer aux démarches de conduite du changement, d’adoption des solutions et d’amélioration continue
.

Exemples de projets

Vous pourrez notamment intervenir sur des projets tels que :

Transformation des processus métiers :
analyse et refonte de processus métiers complexes dans le cadre d’un programme de transformation digitale plus large.
Évolution des systèmes d’information :
traduction des besoins métiers en solutions fonctionnelles et coordination de leur mise en œuvre avec les équipes IT.
Implémentation ou migration d’applications :
accompagnement du remplacement, de l’évolution ou de l’intégration d’applications métiers, de la collecte des besoins jusqu’à la recette et la mise en production.
Transformation du Digital Workplace ou de la Data :
collaboration avec les parties prenantes métiers et IT pour définir de nouvelles solutions et s’assurer de leur adéquation avec les besoins opérationnels.

Votre profil

Une expérience solide en Business Analysis :
vous justifiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle
en tant que Business Analyst, dans des environnements IT et/ou de transformation métier.
Une expertise en analyse des besoins et des processus :
vous êtes à l’aise pour analyser des processus complexes, challenger les exigences et traduire les besoins métiers en solutions fonctionnelles.
Une expérience en gestion de projet :
vous avez déjà évolué dans des environnements projets et maîtrisez les principaux enjeux de gouvernance et de delivery.
Une excellente gestion des parties prenantes :
vous êtes à l’aise pour interagir avec des interlocuteurs métiers comme techniques et adapter votre communication à différents publics.
Un esprit analytique :
vous êtes structuré(e), curieux(se) et capable de comprendre rapidement des environnements complexes.
Une bonne connaissance des méthodologies :
une expérience avec HERMES, Agile, Scrum ou des méthodologies similaires
constitue un réel atout.
Des compétences en modélisation :
une connaissance de UML et/ou BPMN
est un plus.
Formation :
vous êtes titulaire d’un Master ou d’un diplôme d’enseignement supérieur équivalent
.
Langues :
vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français
et disposez d’un niveau professionnel en anglais
.
Un esprit conseil :
vous appréciez évoluer dans des environnements variés, prendre des responsabilités et apporter une valeur concrète à vos clients
.

Envie de donner un nouvel élan à votre carrière dans le conseil ? Rejoignez d²X !

jobs.description:
About Us:

Turnkey Projects LLC is a Dubai-based renovation company dedicated to transforming spaces with precision, creativity, and craftsmanship. We specialise in high-end residential and commercial renovations and are known for our attention to detail, client-focused approach, and high standards of quality.

IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This position is specifically for candidates with 3-6 years of hands-on Site Engineer experience in the UAE interior fit-out / renovation industry only.

The following are mandatory:

Minimum 3 years of UAE interior fit-out / renovation experience.
Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering.
G+1 certification with Dubai Municipality.
Valid UAE Driving Licence with own vehicle.

Candidates without UAE fit-out/renovation experience, a UAE driving licence, and their own vehicle will not be considered.

This is not an office-based coordination position. We are looking for a hands-on Site Engineer who can independently manage day-to-day site activities, subcontractors, materials, quality, project reports, project programmes, site measurements, drawing coordination, inspections, snagging, and the timely completion of fit-out works.

About the Role:

Turnkey Renovations is looking for an experienced Site Engineer / Jr. Project Manager with strong UAE interior fit-out and renovation experience who is ready to take the next step toward project management.
This is a hands-on role for someone who understands fit-out execution, finishing works, subcontractor coordination and site management and wants to gradually take ownership of projects and client coordination.

Key Responsibilities:

Site & Technical

Supervise daily fit-out and renovation works and ensure execution follows approved drawings and specifications.
Take accurate site measurements and communicate existing site conditions and technical requirements to the team.
Review drawings, identify discrepancies and coordinate solutions before work proceeds.
Inspect finishing works and ensure quality standards are maintained.
Coordinate inspections and ensure snags are closed promptly.

Project Coordination

Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers and multiple trades to maintain project progress.
Monitor project schedules, material deliveries and site logistics.
Assist with procurement, material planning and resource allocation.
Prepare progress updates and communicate project status to the team and clients.
Follow up on outstanding works and ensure agreed deadlines are met.

Project Management

Communicate with Management regarding site progress.
Support the Sr. Project Manager in managing project timelines, costs, deliverables and requirements .
Gradually take ownership of assigned projects from planning through completion.

Other Requirements:

Strong hands-on experience with interior finishing works.

Ability to read and understand architectural, interior and MEP drawings.

Good knowledge of UAE/Dubai construction requirements.
Strong communication skills.

Who We’re Looking For:

If you are hands-on Jr. Site Engineer with proven UAE interior fit-out and renovation experience and technically confident, organized and proactive, with strong knowledge of finishing works and the ability to coordinate subcontractors and multiple trades. Looking to move beyond day-to-day site supervision and grow into a Sr. Site Engineer / Jr. Project Manager role, we would like to hear from you.

﻿ Note:

Please apply only if you meet the mandatory requirements above, particularly UAE fit-out experience, Civil Engineering qualification, G+1 certification, UAE driving licence and own vehicle.

2 years of experience in business intelligence or data analytics.

Experience with statistical concepts to lead experimentation frameworks (including A/B and incrementality tests) to measure and drive conversion funnel performance.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience with data warehousing or data modeling concepts.
Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Python, or R).
Experience with translating business requirements to BI solutions.
Experience with explaining technical analysis to stakeholders.
Experience with growth and scaled marketing channels.

About the job
Google’s Global Partnerships team powers extraordinary user experiences through partnerships that solve users’ needs, advance goals, and further our mission. Our team provides meaningful solutions — from helping publishers and developers expand through monetization solutions, to helping long-term allies anticipate and navigate change in a way that delivers economic and reputational value.

The Google Partners - Sellside Monetization team's mission is to fund the world's information by enabling online publishers, app developers, and media buyers to scale using our portfolio of products including AdSense, AdMob, and Google Ad Manager. We provide innovative, industry-leading online advertising solutions for our ecosystem, representing the largest platforms and buyers. We do this by enriching an open and healthy digital advertising environment, developing trusted products that can be relied on, and exceeding expectations to strengthen long-term relationships.

As a Marketing Data Analyst, you will power the future of publisher strategy by empowering clients to maximize content business and ensure a thriving, sustainable, ad-supported open internet. This role sits within the Publisher Intelligence team and is focused on driving through innovative testing initiatives. In this role, you will cross-functionally team up to deliver valuable customer insights and leverage analytics to inform key decisions.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $96000 - $136000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Analyze marketing channel performance to optimize growth strategies across key scaled channels, such as email, events, social media, websites, etc., and identify new opportunities to grow via data-driven recommendations.
Lead campaign experimentation and incrementality analyses to measure business impact of marketing efforts and inform future investments to maximize impact of marketing spend.
Develop and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and infrastructure to automate marketing operations and provide insight into business and campaign performance.
Develop a nuanced understanding of customer user journeys through customer research and data analysis to provide actionable market and customer insights for our marketing programs.
Cross-collaborate across Marketing, Product, Legal, and Sales teams across a variety of work streams while adhering to Google brand guidelines.

This remote position offers the flexibility to work from anywhere, empowering candidates to lead high-impact financial initiatives across diverse organizational units. The successful candidate will oversee complex projects related to financial planning, analysis, and process optimization, ensuring strategic alignment and operational efficiency. This role demands excellent analytical skills, stakeholder management, and a proactive approach to problem-solving, with the goal of driving financial performance and supporting the company’s long-term objectives.

Qualifications

To be considered for this role, candidates should possess a minimum of 7 years of experience in finance, accounting, or financial project management. A strong proficiency in financial modeling, Excel, and ERP systems is essential. Candidates must demonstrate exceptional analytical abilities, with the capacity to interpret and synthesize complex financial data into actionable insights. Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing diverse stakeholder groups is highly valued. Additionally, a solid understanding of accounting standards such as GAAP and IFRS is required. A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field is mandatory, with advanced certifications like CPA, CFA, or CMA considered a plus.
